at Microsoft.Playwright.Core.AssertionsBase.ExpectImplAsync(String expression, FrameExpectOptions expectOptions, Object expected, String message) in /_/src/Playwright/Core/AssertionsBase.cs:line 98
   at SmartCommerce.E2E.Pages.OrderHistoryPage.AssertCarrierTrackingStatusAsync(String expectedStatusText) in C:\repo\SmartCommerce.E2E\Pages\OrderHistoryPage.cs:line 69
   at SmartCommerce.E2E.Tests.OrderHistoryTests.InTransitOrder_VerifyLiveCarrierWebhookBadge_ShouldShowOutForDelivery() in C:\repo\SmartCommerce.E2E\Tests\OrderHistoryTests.cs:line 119
root_cause: The RabbitMQ carrier webhook consumer processes shipment status transitions asynchronously (~3-5 seconds after order creation), and the React UI only polls on page reload. `AssertCarrierTrackingStatusAsync` checked the static DOM pill without triggering a poll refresh.
resolution: Wrapped the assertion in `AssertCarrierTrackingStatusAsync` (`OrderHistoryPage.cs`, line 69) inside `Assertions.Expect(async () => { await _page.ReloadAsync(); await Assertions.Expect(LiveCarrierTrackingBadge).ToHaveTextAsync(expectedStatusText); }).ToPassAsync()`.
